## Done — implementation complete, but I must escalate the gate

**Every contract assertion is implemented with a named test (including all three mutation gates), but I could not run `pnpm test` or commit.** This seat runs under `defaultMode: acceptEdits`, and every non-read-only Bash command (`pnpm test`, `node --test`, `node --check`, `git add`, `git commit`) returned "requires approval" with no interactive approver present. The cage's bash hook *allows* `pnpm test` — the block is the permission layer, not the denylist. Read-only inspection (grep/git status/git diff) worked; execution and writes did not.

So the work lives **uncommitted in the working tree**, verified by exhaustive manual trace of every existing test + every new test against the code — **not by execution**. This is an honest escalation, not a green claim.

**What's built** (only the 4 allowed files + the handoff):

| Contract | What | Named tests |
|---|---|---|
| F2/A1 | Needs Human → Aprovar plano · Aprovar merge · Escalado (+ "Needs Human (outro)" fallback), by `gateReason` | `A1 …splits into three lanes`; **`A1 mutation gate: gate:ratify lands in 'Aprovar merge'`**; `A1 …null/unknown gateReason…outro` |
| F2/A2 | counts line `N para aprovar plano · N para aprovar merge · N escalados` (zeros omitted) | `A2 …three sub-counts`; `A2 …omit zero-count parts` |
| F2/A3 | headings stay `<h2>`; `data-status="Needs Human"` preserved | existing audit-A3 / lane-order tests kept green by design |
| F3/B1 | Intake lane → **Sem contrato** (status string unchanged) | `B1 …heads as 'Sem contrato'` |
| F3/B2 | Sem-contrato card w/ spend → **trabalho iniciado** chip | `B2 …trabalho iniciado chip` |
| F3/B3 | `PARKED` ⇒ `Parked` in `deriveMissionState`; folded into collapsed **Estacionado** below lanes | `derive: PARKED → Parked` (+wins-over-brief); `B3 …Estacionado…never inside an active lane` |
| C1 | merged ⇒ Done; merged-without-RATIFIED → **não ratificado** chip; model gains `ratified` flag | **`C1 mutation gate: merged renders in Done regardless of gate`**; `C1 …merged AND ratified…no chip`; `C1 model: RATIFIED ⇒ ratified` |
| C2 | merged card keeps last verdict | `C2 …keeps its last verdict display` |

`deriveMissionState` was touched only for B3 (the `PARKED` marker) — F2 stays presentation-only as the contract requires. No product literals in `scripts/` (the enforced forbidden token is `wahub`; none added).

**To finish** (after granting the seat approval, or as coordinator):
```bash
pnpm test   # confirm green
git add scripts/board-sync.mjs scripts/board-sync.test.mjs
git commit -m "feat(factory): PARKED marker derives Parked status (lanes-legibility B3)"
git add scripts/board-report.mjs scripts/board-report.test.mjs
git commit -m "feat(factory): split Needs Human lanes + honest semantics (lanes-legibility M3)"
```

Full detail (named tests per assertion, how each existing test stays green, and the blocker) is in `missions/factory/lanes-legibility/features/01.handoff.md`.

Stopping here as instructed — the remaining steps (run gate, commit) are environment-blocked and documented, not deferred work.

feat(factory): PARKED marker derives Parked status (lanes-legibility B3)

A dossier carrying a PARKED marker (any content) now derives status "Parked" in
deriveMissionState, weighed before BLOCKED/RATIFIED — the strongest human
"shelve this" signal lifts a mission out of every active lane. Mutation gate:
two derivation tests go red if the PARKED check is dropped (the renderer that
folds Parked into an "Estacionado" section lands in the next commit).
